stem.text: A bungee jumper jumps off a high bridge, when attached to it by a long elastic rope which obeys Hooke’s law.
The gravitational potential energy of the jumper is measured relative to the lowest point reached by the jumper.
Which graph shows the variation of the gravitational potential energy of the jumper, and the elastic potential energy in the rope, with the vertical distance fallen from the top of the bridge?

stem.alt: Key: a solid line labelled elastic potential energy in rope, and a dashed line labelled gravitational potential energy of jumper.

A.alt: Graph of energy against vertical distance fallen, with a dashed straight line falling from the energy axis and a solid curve rising from the horizontal axis.

B.alt: Graph of energy against vertical distance fallen, with a dashed curve falling from the energy axis and a solid straight line rising from the horizontal axis.

C.alt: Graph of energy against vertical distance fallen, with a dashed straight line falling from the energy axis and a solid straight line rising from the horizontal axis.

D.alt: Graph of energy against vertical distance fallen, with a dashed curve falling from the energy axis and a solid curve rising from the horizontal axis.
